title: The three-dimensional symplectization question for small Seifert L-spaces and further classes
summary: We solve the three-dimensional symplectization question for several examples. These include small Seifert fibered $L$-spaces, a family of Whitehead-link surgery $L$-spaces, $S^1\times S^2$, certain surgeries on the figure-eight knot, explicit families of Brieskorn spheres, and arbitrary finite connected sums mixing these manifolds. In particular, the result covers the Weeks manifold and infinitely many hyperbolic $L$-spaces.
